Good work bridging and scouting. Do not cross the second shaft; return to guard Lange's build and mark the near side of the bridge hazard with torches. Remain alert.

Oak planks are now at Lange's site chest. Return safely to base via existing route or return_to_surface; do not approach open shafts. Once back, equip full diamond armor, shield and sword, then deliver 64 cobblestone to site chest (-87,120,-7). Report completion or obstruction.

Your last position appears below base level. Return safely to surface/base using return_to_surface; avoid shafts and do not scout alone. Then mark the safe north/west approaches with torches and report route and any obstacles.

Continue shelter as sole builder; site chest at (-87,120,-7) has 64 stone bricks, 64 planks, 64 bricks and 32 torches. Complete floor, 3-high walls, door, roof and interior lighting; report obstacles or needed supplies.

Marked near side of bridge with torch at (-75,120,-10) after clearing leaves; second placement was not needed. I am on the near side at (-77,119,-10), guarding the crossing and will stay alert near Lange's build.
Returned to Lange's build perimeter at (-82,-8), fully armored with sword/shield. Spider encounter is over; area currently clear and torches mark bridge hazard.

Good work. Next build a low stone-brick defensive parapet at the base end of the marked bridge, leaving a clear two-block-wide passage and avoiding Lange's shelter footprint. Take supplies from common chests; light it, then report coordinates and completion. Stay alert for mobs.

Completed parapet at base bridge end: 4 stone-brick blocks x=-90..-87, y=120, z=-12, with torches atop at (-89,121,-12) and (-87,121,-12). Kept clear passage toward z=-10/-9 and avoided shelter. Supplies withdrawn from common chest; site cleared.
Parapet complete and inventory still has combat kit. I will scout the Market approach/base perimeter and report fortifications and player presence, without engaging unless ordered.

Parapet completed. Now equip sword, shield, bow, arrows and food, and scout the neutral approach eastward from base without entering the Market base or engaging players. Report terrain, hazards, and visible enemy defenses with coordinates; return to base afterward.

Supply audit: building chest at (-103,126,-4) has cobblestone, doors, ladders, glass, deepslate, torches; (-97,126,-4) has planks, stairs and chests. Continue your assigned shelter to completion; report when finished.

Good scouting. Prepare a safe, torch-marked route from the base toward neutral center: clear only obstructing natural leaves, mark dangerous drops, and do not enter enemy territory or engage alone. Report route and hazards when done.
At -40,75,-6 after patrol; no hostiles/Market sighted. Can take next assigned task; current gear intact.

Return safely along the marked route to the shelter construction at (-91,121,-7); avoid neutral-center mobs and do not engage Market alone. Guard Lange and patrol the approaches during construction, then report any threat or when the shelter is complete.

Site chest at (-87,120,-7) currently has 40 stone bricks, 64 bricks, 64 oak planks, 32 torches, 33 logs and an oak door. Continue the unfinished shelter per build plan; request more supplies when needed.

64 oak planks are ready for your shelter; I am immediately beneath you at (-107,126,2) but cannot path to you. Please retrieve from base wood chest (-97,126,-4), which has 128 more oak planks, or tell me an accessible drop point.

Good work. Stay armed and escort Zappel on a daylight reconnaissance toward neutral center, marking a safe return route; avoid fights and report coordinates and enemy sightings. Return if threatened.
I placed 64 oak planks in the accessible common chest at (-100,126,3), alongside 64 stone bricks, doors and torches. Use these for your shelter; the wood chest at (-97,126,-4) is obstructed.

Maintain active perimeter defense around Lange's shelter, and build a low stone-brick defensive barricade outside his footprint if terrain permits. Leave clear access and coordinate with Lange; report when finished.

Daylight now. I escorted toward neutral but dense terrain blocked route; currently at (-66,110,-1), with torch route behind at (-71,114,-3). No enemy sightings; neutral direction south/east still obstructed by steep terrain/trees. I can continue by clearing a safe path.

Rejoined Zappel at (-78,120,-3), daylight and no hostile/enemy sightings. Torches mark return route through trees (roughly (-86..-74,120,-4)). Terrain toward neutral remains steep/wooded; recommend regroup before pushing farther.

With Zappel, scout a safer alternate route toward neutral via southern flank; clear only natural obstacles, mark route with torches and report coordinates, threats and enemy sightings. Avoid solo attack; stay together and retreat if exposed.
Escort Marcant on southern-flank route reconnaissance toward neutral. Stay together, clear natural obstacles and mark a safe return route; report useful coordinates and threats. Do not attack alone.
Your active shelter takes priority. Please report its exact site, current progress and any blocker or shortage when practical; complete floor, walls, door, roof and lighting before switching tasks.

Check Lange's current build site and deliver any requested materials from common chests, then improve base perimeter defenses without obstructing the shelter or chest access. Report progress and location.

Executed southern-flank clearing attempt; natural canopy/grass obstructs and break operation timed out, but I am safe at (-72,120,0) with diamond gear, healthy, no hostiles/enemy sightings. Existing wall-torch route remains at (-76,120,-3); recommend treating (-72,120,0) as southern waypoint and regroup here.

Regroup with Marcant at southern waypoint (-72,120,0), following your marked route. Work together to reconnoiter a safe pass east toward neutral ground; mark route with torches. Avoid combat and report actionable findings.

Hold the southern waypoint while actively surveying nearby walkable routes and lighting the approach; Zappel is ordered to regroup with you. Then scout east together without attacking, report passable route or enemy sightings.

Southern waypoint now lit at (-73,117,5); cleared oak logs/leaves and leaf-litter/grass blockers around approach. No entities or enemy sightings. Holding position for Zappel and ready to scout east together.

Proceed east scouting toward neutral middle with Zappel if together; if not, scout cautiously on your own without waiting. Mark safe route with torches, report coordinates and enemy sightings; avoid initiating combat.
I delivered 64 glass to site chest (-87,120,-7); use as needed for your shelter. Continue full floor, walls, door, roof and lighting before switching tasks.
